To consider or regard; to include (as in an estimate or plan) or pay attention to; to notice; to allow for, factor in.

examples.text: His plan did not take into account the possibility of rain.

glosses: To take into account.

glosses: To explain by relating circumstances; to show that some one, thing or members of a group are present or have been processed.
